no_adcom_quote.quote: Albiglutide is the fourth member of the GLP-1 agonist class of anti-diabetic drugs. No new efficacy or safety issue identified in the application rose to the level of requiring the input from an advisory panel. Therefore no advisory committee was convened.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the TANZEUM (albiglutide) BLA125431 application. The Summary Review states that albiglutide, as the fourth member of the GLP-1 agonist class of anti-diabetic drugs, raised no new efficacy or safety issue that rose to the level of requiring input from an advisory panel. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
